description: An opaque plain brown knee-length wool tunic or simple outer coat has narrow muted red-and-cream woven borders around the split round neckline, front opening, cuffs and hem. A cream linen undershirt shows at the neck, cuffs and lower hem. A plain brown leather belt with a simple buckle and hanging end closes the waist. Brown trousers and tall dark brown leather boots complete the outfit. Both bare hands rest visibly beside the body, with no headgear, armour, cloak, weapon or regalia.
